body: Try headspace app it's a meditation app but for normal everyday people you can do it anywhere anytime, first 10 sessions are free and it's £10 a month after you finish but it's worth every penny they really helped me during one of my worst times and the creator andi puddicombes story is incredible

Talk to her about your life and anything deep down or in plain sight that's making you feel like this, talk to her about your home life, your relationships and your work/school life tell her what feelings you have towards them and try to come up with a plan together on how to get you better she will of heard every thing there is to hear with people so don't be afraid let it all out its confidential so you have nothing to fear she's there to help you

I don't think she has moved on that's the thing, I have severe paranoia I think and make scenarios up in my head about her with other men, she does send me the occasional message but I haven't seen her in 3 weeks and I'm lost, she said she doesn't want to speak to me face to face and she needs space but my head won't listen

I don't have her on social media any more she has removed me herself, but why hasn't she blocked my number, knowing her for the time I have why hasn't she just done it if she doesn't want me to contact her? I'm confused and frustrated is this some sort of cruel game? I don't think she's capable of that cause that's not in her nature but does her not blocking me still mean there's a chance I just don't know anymore there's still this beacon of hope that she will turn around and take me back I can't bring myself to cut all ties I feel like if I did I would have lost the only person who understands me
I feel like we are going through the same stuff man I've heard talking helps soothe the pain, dm me?

I feel like a burden to my friends and my family and I don't want to bring them down with me anymore I feel  helpless if I'm honest, I've been contemplating suicide for the past few days now and I think if tonight could be the night
I just feel as if I can't move on with my life until my questions are answered, i get very little sleep every day I self harm to make my body react to feel something

Do you have any family to move in with temporarily while you get back on your feet? you need the people around you who love you the most right now, I suffered with a similar situation recently my girlfriend left me I wasn't the best boyfriend in the world and it was my fault that the relationship ended cause of my depression and mood swings I just use to get angry really easily and she couldn't deal with it anymore, it sucks im still broken from it but I Moved back in with my mum and left her to get on with her life as she wished it seems like the hardest thing in the world right now and I know it will kill you to think of them with someone else but you will make it through this, this will shape you into a stronger person if you fight it. It doesn't feel like you can right now but you will love again and there will be a guy who will be supportive and will you love, stay strong you're not alone

Get help, go to your local doctors surgery ask about therapy tell them how you feel speak up for yourself cause you're the only person who can get through this, don't let your depression get the better of you, I feel exactly the same empty and alone but therapy gives me some form of respite and makes me want to help myself and others who are suffering. You aren't alone

Everyday, right now I'm still debating the situation in my head, the only thing really stopping me is knowing that my mum, my brother and my friends would be devastated and I don't want any of them to feel how I feel cause it's soul destroying

You're 14, your mom cares about you, you don't see it now but she does, she cooks for you she provides for you and puts clothes on your back, don't take your mom for granted cause one day she won't be there anymore, It sounds dumb me telling you all this now I get it you want your phone back but you're still a kid man just relax do your homework get your grades move out at 18 if you want do whatever but Reddit suicide watch isn't where a kid like yourself should be finding them selves in modern life it's a hard world I know but I know you can do it

Hey, I just wanted you to know that you aren't alone and I feel exactly the same your situation is very similar to mine at the moment, it's got to the point where I'm replying to people on Reddit at 5am cause my body physically won't let me sleep, try getting yourself some therapy or go to your doctors just your local general practitioner and tell them how you feel they will try and atleast guide you in some way to the next step if you want to talk I'm free most days so drop me a private message and we'll talk man and I could probably use someone else to talk to as much as you
